scope_limits: Same-user processes, not OS isolation or authenticated people
One bounded request/result task, no general relationship directory or host adapter
New experimental envelope, no A4A/MCP/native interoperability claim
Memory-only keys; occupied-store restart refused and teardown discards synthetic state
Incoming grants have local lifetime, no clock expiry or distributed cancellation
Processing proof is an authenticated endpoint claim, not external-world truth
Approve_send approves and releases bytes; cancellation cannot recall released packets
